description:
Maybe you're bored and need a new challenge. Or you're sick of all the bureaucracy and just want to focus on building kick-ass software. Or maybe you're looking for a job where you can do really great work from anywhere.

Whatever the reason, we want you to know that LT is different. And not just air-quotes "different," but more like "breathing easy for the first time in a long time" different.

It's a place where you can write your own story and make a difference along the way. At LT, you'll have real ownership over how you approach your work, backed by a team of curious people who trust your judgment and love a good challenge too.

About the Role

We're currently looking to add a Software Engineer with TypeScript, GraphQL, AWS, and Java expertise to this nerd club of ours. If you're someone with 3+ or so years of experience, we'd love to chat.

What You'll Do

 - Join forces with 3-5 other team members to deliver high-quality, low-maintenance software solutions that help organizations cement their place in the digital economy.

 - Help coach and guide client teams on the best approaches to modern software development in order to create scalable and maintainable applications.

 - Use test-driven development practices to help write high-quality code.

 - Continue to refine your craft and grow your skills through ongoing training, personal development, and other learning opportunities that help you reach your goals.

What We're Looking For

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience

 - Hands-on experience with TypeScript

 - Experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs

 - Experience with AWS

 - Experience with Java
years_evidence: - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
